subject: AWS Marketplace: usage instrumentation & SaaS fulfillment checklist
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Angela Ruiz <aws-marketplace-amb@amazon.com>, poc@clearsight.ai
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Marketplace: usage instrumentation & SaaS fulfillment checklist

Hi Angela / ClearSight team,

Following up from last week's call — ClearSight is planning to go live on AWS Marketplace as a SaaS listing and they asked us to validate the metering + fulfillment flow. High-level asks:
- Confirm entitlement model (monthly seats vs. usage metering)
- Instrumentation points for metering calls (what to send at purchase & per-usage)
- Fulfillment/entitlement delivery latency expectations
- DocuSign / contract handshake items required for seller onboarding

Attaching a first-pass CSV that maps our events to AWS Metering API calls (metering_schema_v1.csv). Rafael, can you review the schema and call out any gaps (token counters, subscription id formats, TTL for entitlements)?

Proposed timeline:
- 8/16: tech review + mapping signoff
- 8/18: AWS entitlement validation (test purchase)
- 8/20: procurement handshake / DocuSign out

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Angela Ruiz <aws-marketplace-amb@amazon.com>, poc@clearsight.ai
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace: usage instrumentation & SaaS fulfillment checklist

Ben — quick pass on the CSV and a couple notes:

1) Entitlement mapping
- We should use the AWS entitlement token (EntitlementID) as the canonical key in our internal DB. Map customer_id -> EntitlementID upon fulfillment callback.

2) Metering call payload
- Include: product_code, dimension (users or token_units), usage_quantity, timestamp (ISO8601), customer_identifier (EntitlementID).
- If ClearSight wants seat-based (monthly) billing, send a delta of seats at month-start. For per-inference usage, batch and send every 5 minutes to reduce throttling.

3) Retry semantics
- Use exponential backoff for 429/500, persist to a local queue on failure.

4) Test hooks
- We need a sandbox seller account and a test product_code from AWS. Angela, can you create a sandbox entitlement for ClearSight and share the product_code?

I also uploaded a short mapping doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-mapping-guide

Rafael
Lead Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Angela Ruiz <aws-marketplace-amb@amazon.com>

Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace: usage instrumentation & SaaS fulfillment checklist

Thanks for the summary, Ben and Rafael. Next steps from AWS side:

- I will provision a sandbox product_code and a test entitlement for ClearSight by EOD 8/18. Product_code will be shared in this thread.
- For SaaS (metered) listings we expect the seller to call the Marketplace Metering Service with product_code + dimension + customer_identifier. We can accept batched reports (up to 24 hours) but recommend 5-15 minute batches for production.
- Required contract items: Seller onboarding (standard AWS SaaS agreement), an executed Seller/Partner addendum for marketplace entitlements, and a completed tax/identity form. DocuSign link will follow for ClearSight procurement.

Angela pasted a short checklist:
1) Sandbox product_code: P-CLRSIGHT-2026-SBX (will confirm exact string in follow-up)
2) Seller onboarding package: standard AWS SaaS Agreement + addendum
3) Test purchase flow: we will simulate a purchase and return an EntitlementID. Please ensure your fulfillment endpoint accepts EntitlementID and returns 200 within 10s.

On timelines — 8/18 validation is feasible if your engineers can run the test purchase. Otherwise we shift to the week of 8/24.

Angela Ruiz
AWS Marketplace Partner Manager
aws-marketplace-amb@amazon.com

Great — thanks Angela. Rafael and Priyom will run the sandbox test tomorrow (8/19) and report back.

Marissa / Procurement: ClearSight's procurement team is on this thread (contracts@clearsight.ai). They'll need the standard AWS addendum and a draft SOW that notes data retention (90 days), logs to be shared for audit, and SLA targets for fulfillment latency (99th < 10s). Can your team assemble the DocuSign packet and a one-page MAP? I'll attach a short mutual action plan for reviewers (MAP_v0.2.pdf).

Open items:
- Confirm product_code string from Angela
- Confirm whether ClearSight wants monthly seat billing or per-inference metering (they indicated both possible)
- Get procurement contact to upload PO after signature

Ben
